# v0.6.0 (2026-08-27)
Signed and notarized Release build of Foundation for macOS arm64.
Defaults to production (`https://foundation.trychroma.com`). Uses the saved default CLI profile.
Includes a bundled `foundation` CLI at `Foundation.app/Contents/Resources/foundation` (same version as this Mac release).
## Opening the app
Open the `.dmg` and drag `Foundation.app` onto Applications. Direct downloads should open normally (Developer ID + notarized).
## Changes
* [BUG](mac): Let an empty backfill plan apply (#485) * [TST](sync-client): Fix upload-cap peak over-count flake (#483) * [ENH](coding-agent): Add a local pipeline report (#484) * [ENH](mac): Expose the backfill plan over the bridge (#477) * [ENH](coding-agent): Enforce per-repo backfill cutoffs (#476) * [ENH](coding-agent): Add backfill budget planner (#480) * [ENH](coding-agent): Clean session traces (#479)
